title: Tote bags
slide_intent: Let repeated forms become a pattern because an identity can remain recognizable without repeating one large logo treatment.
strategic_value: Different arrangements of the thin W can give Whitney’s totes variation within a shared visual family.
demonstration: Three natural-fabric totes carry different distributions and proportions of fine W marks.
practical_value: Compare pattern density and variation across a common product shape; these are examples, not required repeat counts.

content_islands.name: Tote family
content_islands.spec: Align the three bags on gray and preserve the fabric color, handles and distinct W patterns.

reference_purposes.Application: The official caption identifies a series of tote bags for the museum’s retail store.
reference_purposes.Expression: Repeated W forms create three different patterns on the same natural-fabric object.
